name: ycombinator
fieldSelector: textarea, input[type=text], input[type=url], input[type=email], input[type=tel], input:not([type])
skipSelector: input[type=hidden], input[type=submit], input[type=button], input[type=checkbox], input[type=radio], input[type=file], input[type=password], [readonly], [disabled], [aria-hidden=true]
notes: YC autosaves on blur. The form is React, so values must be set through real input events, which is what Playwright fill() does. Password fields are skipped on purpose.
